claims.text: The span detector is part of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) architecture, which includes a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The span detector uses the SAN answer module for its operation.
The architecture incorporates various embeddings, including word embeddings and part-of-speech tagging embeddings, to enhance performance.
